The '''Fourteenth Army''', also known as '''Red Tails Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Tolonda Oversector/Legends|Tolonda Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the Clone Wars, the 14th Sector Army was deployed on the Outer Corellian Run and was primarily a defensive command unit. Its intended role was to protect Rothana, Excarga, and the Rimward approach to Kamino. It also reinforced the [[Thirteenth Army|13th Sector Army]] repeatedly, and was responsible for repelling a Separatist attack in its own theater of operations at Ryloth.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
The 14th [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was first activated by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that marked the beginning of a [[civil war]]&mdash;known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] Rebellion, in addition to nineteen other [[Sector Army/Legends|sector armies]]. Throughout the duration of the Clone Wars, the Fourteenth was [[Headquarters|headquartered]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and charged with the defense of the [[Tolonda Oversector/Legends|Tolonda]] [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]]. The overall command of the Fourteenth was shared between a highly experienced [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and a [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] who was appointed by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the last year of the Clone Wars, the Governor-Generals [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|evolved]] into a permanent class of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] known as the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

As the Clone Wars progressed, Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] promoted [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]] to the rank of Moff, giving him control of the Fourteenth Army and the [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]]. The army was responsible for repelling a CIS attack at Ryloth and for repeatedly reinforcing the 13th Sector Army.

After the conclusion of the Clone Wars, the Old Republic's twenty sector commands were retained by the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-risen]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, Ravik ascended to the rank of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] and maintained the Fourteenth Army. Much of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] was marked by the Empire's massive military buildup and resulted in a [[Imperial Military/Legends|vast army]] far larger than its [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic predecessor]]. Thus, the total infantry force of the Fourteenth Army and all other sector units were increased to approximately 1,572,864 troopers, most of whom were of natural birth as clones became marginalized into a minority status.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fourteenth Army was mentioned in the 2012 Guidebook, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. According to the co-author, [[Paul R. Urquhart]], its nickname, Red Tails Command, was derived from various sources, including the head-tail colors of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] living in the capital of the Tolonda Oversector, and to the 2012 historical-fiction film [[Wikipedia:Red Tails|''Red Tails'']], detailing the exploits of the [[Wikipedia:Tuskegee Airmen|Tuskegee Airmen]] during [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]], which was directed and written by ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]]. There were also plans to have a Twi'lek moff in this section, although they decided that it simply wouldn't fly.<ref name="EGTW endnotes 6">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}</ref>
